title: Period and Graph of y = sin(2x)
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Find the fundamental period of the function y = \sin 2x and describe the key features of its graph over one full cycle.

steps.title: Identify the Angular Frequency and Compute the Period
steps.explanation: Compare y = sin(2x) with y = A*sin((2*pi/B)*x). Here 2*pi/B = 2, so the fundamental period is B = pi.
steps.why: A horizontal compression by a factor of 2 divides the standard 2*pi period of sine by 2.

steps.title: Determine the Amplitude and Range
steps.explanation: The coefficient of sin(2x) is 1, so the wave oscillates with amplitude 1 between y = -1 and y = 1.
steps.why: Since -1 <= sin(2x) <= 1, the extreme values of y are -1 and 1.

steps.title: Locate Key Quarter-Period Points on [0, pi]
steps.explanation: Divide the period [0, pi] into four equal subintervals of length pi/4 to obtain the x-intercepts, maximum, and minimum.
steps.why: A sinusoid attains its zeros and extrema at quarter-period increments.
